meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer: In compliance with the Children’s Internet Protection Act (CIPA), all students and faculty must watch the GISD on-line safety video. Requires that discipline for bullying of a student with disabilities comply with applicable requirements under federal law, including the individuals with Disabilities Education Act (20 U.S.C. Section 1400 et seq.).
